errors.evidence: The description uses the term "син" (blue) for the "Силно съгласен" category, which is ambiguous because there are two shades of blue in the chart. It should have specified "светлосин" (light blue) to distinguish it from "тъмносин" (dark blue).

errors.text_span: за мъжете в групата 45+ най-висок е „Силно съгласен“ (43%)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that for men in the 45+ age group, the highest bar corresponds to "Силно съгласен" (Strongly agree) with a value of 43%. According to the chart, the highest bar for this group is "По-скоро съгласен" (Rather agree) at 43%. The value for "Силно съгласен" is actually 14%.

The description claims that for men aged 26-34, the value for the "По-скоро съгласен" (Rather agree) category is 46%. The chart shows this value is actually 22%. The value 46% corresponds to men aged 19-25 in the "По-скоро несъгласен" (Rather disagree) category.
